empty_none: You haven't finished any games yet.
empty_ranked: No ranked games among the loaded games.
empty_friendly: No friendly games among the loaded games.
empty_solo: No solo games among the loaded games.
meaning_best: The move the engine would have played, or close to it: no loss.
meaning_good: A good move, slightly weaker than the best: less than half a pawn lost.
meaning_inaccuracy: A less accurate move: between half a pawn and a pawn and a quarter lost.
meaning_mistake: A move that lets your opponent take the advantage: up to three pawns lost.
meaning_blunder: A move that changes the game, often leaving a piece or a mate: more than three pawns lost.
sentence_best_you: You played {move}: it's the best move.
sentence_alt_you: You played {move}; the best move was {best} ({eval}).
explain_best_mate: The best move: it leads to a forced mate.
explain_best: The best move: the engine sees nothing stronger.
explain_good: Good move: almost as strong as the best ({loss} behind).
explain_inaccuracy: Inaccuracy: this move gives up about {loss} of advantage. Nothing serious, but there was better.
explain_mistake: Mistake: this move loses about {loss} of advantage. Your opponent can take advantage of it.
explain_mistake_mate: Mistake: this move loses about {loss} of advantage. Your opponent now has a forced mate.
explain_blunder: Blunder: this move loses {loss} of advantage, often a piece or a mate. Your opponent clearly takes over.
explain_blunder_mate: Blunder: this move loses {loss} of advantage, often a piece or a mate. Your opponent now has a forced mate.
explore_illegal: That move isn't possible in this position.
explore_too_long: The variation is too long (200 actions maximum).
err_full: This game has reached its maximum of 50 spectators.
err_missing: This game doesn't exist or has already ended.
err_in_game: You're already in a game: finish it before watching another.
error_hint: You can find your finished games under “My games”.
check_white: Check: the white king is under attack.
check_black: Check: the black king is under attack.
shortcuts: Shortcuts: ← → to step forward or back, Home / End, Space to start playback, F to flip the board.
run_analysis_hint: Run the analysis to see the quality of each move.
run_analysis_move: Run the analysis to see the quality of this move.
chart_aria: Evaluation curve: click to jump to a move
chart_valuetext: Move {index}, evaluation {eval} (from White's point of view)
see_best: Show the best move on the board
explore_help: From move {ply}. Play moves or skills on the board: the recorded game is not modified.
variation_empty: No moves played yet: {color} to move.
legend_intro: The engine compares each move with the best possible move. The gap is counted in pawns: one pawn of advantage is worth 1.0. The bigger the gap, the harsher the label.
analysing_sub: The engine evaluates each move, for up to 25 seconds.
analysis_intro: The engine rates each move (best, good, inaccuracy, mistake, blunder) and calculates each player's accuracy.
summary_caption: Number of moves per label and per side
redo_summary: Run again at a different depth
